title: zazzle setup component diagram
description: Setup plans from the clients' settings files, applies the plan to them, the instruction files, Claude Code's hook and the proxy LaunchAgents, and checks the result by talking to every configured server. The clients, their settings files and the servers are outside the repository.

components.name: zazzle setup
components.responsibility: Configures MCP clients to use zazzle and the zazzle proxy, reversibly, and checks them.

components.name: Plan, apply and undo (mod.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses the options and finds the environment; plans each client's operations (add or remove zazzle, wrap or unwrap stdio servers, route or unroute HTTP servers, leave with a reason); reports them; with --apply or --undo writes the settings files with backups, the instructions block, the Claude Code and Codex hooks, the workspaces file and the setup record, and starts or stops proxy agents. Lists plugin and project servers it leaves direct.

components.name: Client settings files (clients.rs)
components.responsibility: Knows Claude Code's ~/.claude.json, the desktop app's claude_desktop_config.json and Codex's config.toml; lists their servers by kind and edits entries while keeping the rest of each file.

components.name: Check (check.rs)
components.responsibility: Starts each configured stdio server with its client's command, environment and folder, or posts to each HTTP server with its headers, and does initialize, tools/list and for zazzle zazzle_overview, reporting what works and what to fix. Marks each server zazzle, proxied or direct, each client's routing enforced or instructed, repository access, and summarizes the activity log (--report).

components.name: LaunchAgents (src/launchd.rs)
components.responsibility: Writes, loads and unloads the agents that keep HTTP proxies running.

components.name: zazzle MCP proxy (src/proxy)
components.responsibility: What wrapped and routed servers run behind.

components.name: Verify (verify.rs)
components.responsibility: Exercises zazzle through a real `zazzled mcp` inside a repository and from the home folder, runs a command and the wrapped servers and hooks, and shows the activity entries produced.

relationships.description: Wraps and routes servers through `zazzled proxy`.
Its MCP session and hook self-test.
